meaning: The portal has not switched salon online booking on yet (answered after the sync key check, before the body is read). Send Retry-After: 3600.
tillDoes: Makes no salon call for an hour (or Retry-After if longer), then tries again. Shows the reason on Salon / Barber → Online booking → Status. Push and pull are unaffected.

meaning: The key's shop is not a Salon / Barber shop on the portal (setup.business_type is not Salon), or the portal has the salon add-on off for it.
tillDoes: Pauses salon calls a minute at a time and shows the message on the Status tab. A till only calls when its own shop type is Salon / Barber, so this means the two sides disagree: the shop calls support.

meaning: The booking page is over 8 MB once unzipped (a very large menu and team over many days ahead).
tillDoes: Shows the message on the Status tab; the shop lowers 'Book up to (days ahead)'. The heartbeat carries on, so the page stays in request-only mode at worst.

meaning: The portal has no phone join with this id for the calling shop (dropped after 15 minutes, or another shop's). rejectedKey = the join id.
tillDoes: Moves on; the ticket it made stays in the queue (the desk sees it with the 'online' mark) and its place is still pushed.
